title_en: Shuklatirth (a pilgrimage site on the Narmada)
translation:
Shuklatirth

Dada Sukhji, also known as Jasvantji, was a disciple of Gyaniji Maharaj. His disciple, Gopaldas of Choranda, was in turn the guru of Jivanji.

As their place of residence, this Shuklatirth deserves to be reckoned a historic site, and in this way it is a holy place (punya sthali). No memorial of this great soul remains there, but it is a holy place as the abode of Dada Sukhji.
